tbesh_html:
1) to give, provide, ascribe, come
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to give
1a2) to set, place
1a3) to provide (with reflexive)
1a4) to ascribe (glory)
1a5) to grant, permit, come now
Aramaic equivalent: ye.hav (יְהַב "to give" H3052)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
strongs_1890.kjv_def: ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.
